alignments.note: Verb with its auxiliary; head on the lexical verb (rule 24).
Supplied *The* joins the noun (rule 15); the marginal gloss 'Hebrew grass' was read and set aside under rule 38.
Niphal; the reflexive *itself* realizes the verb's own voice and stays with it (rule 44).
Supplied *the* joins the nominal expression; head on *grass* under rule 31's tie-break, reading *tender* as the ASV's specifier on a class noun.
Auxiliary and the phrasal *in* belong to the verb; *gathered in* is one lexical rendering of אָסַף (rule 44).
Rectum takes the *of* (rule 19); no article morpheme stands on it, so its *the* is supplied and joins the noun.

review_notes: Competing head for s005: *tender*, on the reading that דֶּשֶׁא names new growth and *grass* is the supplied generic; taken on *grass* because the ASV writes *grass* alone for Hebrew words of that class, which is rule 31's tie-break.
